balls.text: full ball driven to extra cover, Lee takes an easy single but VRV comes back for a non-existent second and gets himself run out
Lee's hit that into the exosphere! He got under a full ball and hit it so high in the air, it cleared the long-off boundary with ease but that went more high than far!
this time he backs away towards the leg side and tries to slog the ball, he misses and Ronchi underarms the ball back towards the stumps, he hits and Lee steals the bye off the rebound
VRV Singh backs away and flat bats his first delivery over extra cover for four, unorthodox but certainly effective

Kulkarni surprises Sreesanth with a sharp bouncer, Sreesanth was committed on to the front foot and fended the ball away from front of his face, the ball smacked his glove and went straight up to Luke Ronchi, Punjab nine down now
driven off the front foot towards long off for a single

lbw! Chawla tries to play a reverse sweep off his first ball, it was a full ball that pitched just in line with leg stump, Chawla missed it and was hit on the pad, difficult to say whether it would have gone on to hit but umpire Sahiba thought it was out
bowled fast down leg side, Ronchi does well to get a glove to it
a fast full toss from Harbhajan, Lee swats it towards long on where Uthappa moves to his right and dives, he slides past the ball and lets it go for four, he holds his head in dismay
driven powerfully this time but straight to the fielder at extra cover
Lee moves across his stumps, gets down on one knee and sweeps Harbhajan powerfully towards deep square leg for four

Sangakkara tries to reach 100 with a six but holes out! He slog swept a flat and fast delivery high in the air towards deep square leg, Kulkarni was stationed on the boundary and he took a simple catch, high but relatively easy
bowled flat and fast on off stump, driven down the ground towards long-off for two more
the free hit ball is a yorker outside off stump, Lee tries to squeeze it on the off side and gets beaten
full toss and Kulkarni had overstepped as well, Lee drove it firmly back at the bowler, Kulkarni fielded and threw the ball back at the batsman's stumps, had he hit Lee would have been out
driven towards long-on for a single
caught! Sohal gets beaten by the slower ball and his attempt at clearing the boundary falls right into Nehra's hands at mid-off, simple catch and Mumbai are fighting back impressively
banged in short outside off stump, Sohal can't reach it, one for the over
full ball outside off stump, driven off the front foot towards cover
Sangakkara backs away and slashes at a good length ball outside off stump, he slices the ball towards third man for two more
Harbhajan slips in the doosra outside off stump, the batsman gets on to the front foot to defend and is beaten
defended towards backward point
caught! Jayawardene got into position to play the reverse pull, the ball was flat and fast and Jayawardene hit it straight to short third man who took an easy catch
driven towards deep cover, just the single this time
bowled flat and fast outside off stump, Sangakkara clears his front foot out of the way and slogs the ball down to the long-on boundary
Jayawardene moves back and cuts Harbhajan towards short third man for a single
Jayawardene backs away and tries to run the ball past short third man but can't find the gap
too full on middle stump, Jayawardene moves across and flicks the ball wristily behind square, the fielder at deep square leg cuts it off in the nick of time
full length on off stump, Sangakkara drives off the front foot to long off
full ball on middle stump, Sangakkara drives hard, very hard right back at Bravo who fields it brilliantly, that ball was traveling and the momentum caused Bravo to stumble as he fielded it
bowled full in the block hole, Sangakkara drives firmly but back to Bravo
the slower ball wide outside off stump, Sangakkara makes room and cuts the ball in front of point, the sweeper fielder has no chance
that's stunning, Jayawardene plants his front foot forward and flicks a short of a length ball from off and middle stump over the deep backward square leg boundary, sheer cheek
Sangakkara moves towards leg and drives the ball towards long off, he didn't time that all that well
this time he backs away yet again and connects, he cuts the ball wide of the short third man fielder for four more
short of a length ball from Khote, Sangakkara backs away and tries to cut through the off side but misses
awesome placement, Sangakkara moves across his stumps to create the angle necessary to flick a ball off his hips from middle stump past the fielder at short fine leg
Jayawardene pushes forward at the ball and gets an outside edge towards third man
Jayawardene opens the face and runs the ball towards third man to get off the mark

caught! Sarwan backs away towards the leg side and tries to loft a good length ball over extra cover, he doesn't get the necessary elevation and Harbhajan hardly has to move to take the catch at waist height
Sarwan moves towards the leg side and drives towards long-off, Uthappa mis-fields and Sangakkara sprints back for the second
Sangakkara moves forward and across his stumps, he ends up forcing a yorker length delivery from middle stump towards Harbhajan at wide mid-off
cut off the back foot towards point for a single
Sangakkara tries to slog the ball through the off side, he gets beaten by a slower ball and gets an inside edge towards Ronchi's right, he dives and gets a glove to it
Sangakkara backs away to make room and cuts the ball towards third man
Sarwan comes down the track and tries to hit through the off side, he gets an inside edge on the on side instead

Sangakkara lofts, Sangakkara mis-cues but he survives, he backed away to make room and tries to loft the ball over cover, he hits it high in the air but there is some mis-communication between Pollock and Tiwary and the ball falls safe
banged in short by Khote, Sangakkara tries to hook but misses, that's the bouncer for the over
Khote strays on to the hips, Sangakkara moves across his stumps and glances the ball past short fine leg, deep square leg runs across to field
good length outside off stump, Sarwan backs away and drives towards long-off, he's not timed it well
driven firmly off the front foot towards mid-off where Harbhajan dives to his left and saves runs
short of a length and wide outside off stump, Sarwan moves back and drives hard to Sangakkara's team-mate Jayasuriya who is at point
a slower ball from Kulkarni, Sangakkara works the ball off his pads towards deep midwicket, he wanted two but slipped at the end of the first run
wide outside off stump, Sangakkara chased it and tried to cut through the offside but got a bottom edge into the ground
short of a length ball outside off stump, Sarwan waits for it and opens the face to run the ball towards third man
good length ball outside off stump, Sarwan plays it off the front foot towards the off side

caught! and splendidly caught! Yuvraj once again punched a good length ball with supreme timing towards long off, maybe he should have hit it with a full flourish this time because Bravo was able to run forward and dive low to take the sharp catch inches off the ground, Yuvraj was unsure whether it was taken but it was and he has to go
Sangakkara backs away towards the leg side and drives a full ball towards long-off for a single
full ball and Yuvraj drives straight and hard down the ground, this time he'll only get a single for long-off is very straight
short ball and Yuvraj has clobbered it, he pulled that so hard that the ball reached the boundary even with two men on the ropes

that's a full toss from Pollock and Yuvraj's dispatched it, he merely punched that, there was no follow through of the bat at all, it was hit effortlessly but the timing was immaculate, the ball sailed over the long-on boundary and brought up the 100
fullish length outside off stump, Sangakkara gets down on one knee and drives powerfully towards cover
short of a length delivery on middle stump, Yuvraj backs away towards leg stump and cuts the ball through cover
Sangakkara comes down the pitch and pulls Bravo to long on
Sangakkara moves across his stumps and tries to play a slog sweep of sorts, he gets beaten by a slower ball from Bravo
short and wide outside off stump, Sangakkara goes on the back foot and cuts to deep point, the batsmen sprint through for two
good length ball on off stump angling into middle, Sangakkara waits in his crease and drives towards mid-on
Yuvraj waits on the back foot and opens the face off the bat to play the short of a length ball towards third man
fired in quickly into the blockhole, Sangakkara digs it out back towards the bowler
reverse swept for a single
Sangakkara moves back and pulls the ball through wide mid-on for a single
cut off the back foot towards point
bowled flat through the air on off stump, Yuvraj meets it with a straight bat and drives powerfully down the ground, Pollock dives on the boundary to stop the four

Goel's run out! Sangakkara came out of his crease and drove the ball hard towards cover, Bravo fumbles but recovers quickly, and there never was a single in it for Goel was lookign at the ball, Sangakkara called for the run and Goel responded late, he was miles short when Ronchi broke the stumps
defended back towards the bowler on the front foot
Goel responds and how! Bravo tests him again with another bouncer but this time the line is outside off stump, Goel gets under it and upper cuts the ball over the third man boundary

that's a sharp bouncer from Bravo, Goel tries to pull but it's too quick for him, he gets a top edge and the ball smacks him flush on the grill, he drops his bat and removes his helmet, Goel's got a cut lip, Harbhajan goes up to have a look at him
banged in short over the stumps, Goel ducks under it
driven powerfully through the covers, there's a fielder in the deep so it's just the single
too full and too wide outside off stump, Sangakkara moves forward and crashes Bravo through cover point for four more, he's just scored the second fastest 50 of the tournament
pulled towards deep backward square leg, the ball goes one bounce to the fielder
played off the back foot towards short third man
tight line on off stump from round the wicket, Sangakkara pushes the ball towards the off side and calls Goel through for one
Sangakkara is finding the boundary with supreme ease, he gets down on one knee and sweeps Harbhajan effortlessly towards the long leg boundary
bowled flat through the air outside leg stump, the ball goes on to hit the left-hander on the pad but that's never going to be out
fullish length outside off stump, Sangakkara leans into it and thunders the drive towards Harbhajan at mid-off, he can't stop it, he should have, that's yet another four for Punjab
Sangakkara backs away towards leg side, Kulkarni tries to counter by bowling wide outside off stump, that's a little too wide says the umpire
Sangakkara makes room and tries to pull once again, this time Kulkarni follows him with a slower ball, Sangakkara gets an inside edge that runs past short fine leg for four more
driven firmly back towards Kulkarni on the front foot

awesome! Sangakkara backs away towards the leg side and comes down the track as well, there's not much room to work with but Sangakkara swings hard and pulls the ball over the wide long-on boundary, that's the first six of the innings
Sangakkara takes a step down the track an tries to swing a good length ball from outside off on the leg side, he mis-times it towards midwicket
smashed hard and straight but he's hit it right to the fielder at mid-on
Sangakkara moves forward and pushes the ball towards cover where a mis-field allows the batsman three more runs
Sangakkara goes ariborne, he slices the ball over the off side but it falls safe towards deep point, three fielders converge on the ball
Pollock once again tries the slower ball and once again he strays down leg side, fine leg is in the circle and Sangakkara flicks the ball off his hips past him for yet another boundary
timing! Pure timing! Sangakkara waits in his crease and cuts a short of a length ball past gully, it was just a bit wide from Pollock and Sangakkara made full use of it
good length delivery on middle stump, defended on the front foot back to the bowler
Pollock strays down leg side with the slower ball, Sangakkara tries to work it behind square but misses
phew! Some shot that, Sangakkara moves across his stumps to a good length ball and flicks it powerfully through midwicket, sublime use of the wrists from Sangakkara
Goel pulls and Goel clears the in-field, he didn't time that well but just got enough on it to pull the short ball over mid-on
the length is slightly short from Nehra, Sangakkara waits in his crease and runs the ball towards third man
Sangakkara! He charges Nehra and dispatches a full ball straight past the bowler with a ferocious straight drive, superb shot, elegant too
this time he pushes hard at it and gets an outside edge that flies just wide of Uthappa's left at first slip towards third man
136 kmh on a good length outside off, Nehra's giving nothing away and Goel once again misses the ball while trying to play it on the off side
Goel fishes outside the off stump at a good length ball from Nehra and gets beaten
this time Goel manages to connect with a pull and gets a single although he didn't time it well
that is a curious ball! Pollock bowled an extremely slow bouncer, Goel was into the pull short a hour too early, he missed it completely and got smacked on the helmet
flicked off the pads towards square leg for a single
smashing drive, Sangakkara moves forward to a full ball and punches it perfectly into the gap between cover and mid-off

oh Sangakkara's all over the place, he tried to charge Pollock but was beaten by a slower ball, he tried to pull but was hit on the body, he then tried to look for a single but had to scamper back before the throw came in from gully
Pollock persists with his tight off stump line, Goel opens the face and runs the ball down to third man
full ball on off and middle, Sangakkara moves back and flicks the ball off his pads towards mid-on
excellent ball, pitches on a good length outside off, Sangakkara tries to drive through the off side but gets beaten

caught! Nehra pitches it short and Pathan tries to pull it from outside off stump, he makes contact with the bottom of his bat and hits it straight to Kulkarni at mid-on, he takes a simple catch at chest height
Goel moves forward and flicks the ball in the air towards mid-on, he sets off for a single and had there been a direct hit this time, Goel would have been spending quality time in the dug out
good length on middle stump, played off the pads towards midwicket

there's a direct hit that has gone for four off the rebound, will be be five? or out? Pathan pushed the ball off his pads towards midwicket and set off for the single, the fielder threw down the stumps at the bowlers end but Pathan was just home, so that's five runs to Punjab
good length from Pollock on middle stump, Goel works it off his pads towards midwicket
Goel steps out to Pollock, realises that he isn't to the pitch and plays it uppishly towards cover
Pathan stands in his crease and punches a good length ball towards Harbhajan at mid-off and calls for the single once again, well run
short of a length on off stump, Goel waits on the back foot and drops it with soft hands towards point for a single, Punjab are away
once again Pollock tests Goel with the tight line outside off stump, Goel tries to chop it towards third man but gets beaten
Pollock starts predictably, on a perfect length angling across the left-hander's off stump, fantastic line, the batsman lets it go
that's it, Punjab have won their first match of the tournament, Nehra digs the last ball towards point to end the game
bowled short outside the off stump, Nehra lets it go through to Sangakkara
banged in short on middle and leg stump, Nehra moves across his stumps and fends it down
full ball on off stump, defended off the front foot towards the off side
short of a length delivery outside off stump, defended off the back foot towards backward point
played towards point off the back foot
good length again from VRV outside off, Kulkarni gets beaten
Nehra moves forward and defends, the good length ball hits the outside edge and speeds towards third man where a sharp piece of fielding from Pathan saves the four
good length ball on off stump, driven on the up through the off side for a single
short of a length delivery gets big on Kulkarni who tries to fend at it without moving his feet, he gets beaten
another short ball from VRV, Kulkarni ducks once again
good length delivery just outside off stump, Kulkarni lets it go through to Sangakkara
short ball over the stumps, it's been called wide for height after Kulkarni ducked under it
the yorker bowled at 140 kmh on middle stump, defended back towards the bowler
full ball outside off stump, driven off the front foot through cover point
full and wide outside off stump, Kulkarni backs away but gets beaten by the length and pace
Nehra gets squared up by a bouncer which he defends awkwardly in the air behind point, Sreesanth had over-stepped so there's a free hit coming up
defended on the front foot towards midwicket

bowled him! or is it hitwicket? Khote backed away once again to make room to slice the ball on the off side, Sreesanth bowled a full and fast ball on off stump, it appeared as though Khote hit his leg stump with his bat while he was bringing it down and then the ball crashed into off stump after he missed the shot
Khote backs away and slices a full toss from Sreesanth over backward point for over
Lee finishes with a short ball, Kulkarni backs away and tries to hit it through the off side, he misses
another slower full ball at 121 kmh, Kulkarni moves forward and plays the ball on the off side
Lee slips in the slower yorker on off and middle stump, defended back towards the bowler
fuller length on off stump, pushed off the front foot towards the off side
banged in short again by Lee, Kulkarni ducks under it, we're just going through the motions now
Lee bangs the ball in short, Khote tries to pull but doesn't make proper contact
the slower ball bowled full on off and middle, Kulkarni backs away and drives firmly towards Yuvraj at cover
another short ball over the stumps, Kulkarni takes evasive action by ducking
tight line and length on off stump, defended on the back foot
good length ball outside the off stump, Kulkarni tries to duck

magic! Magic catch! Pollcok gets under a low full toss on off stump and tries to loft once again over cover, this time Yuvraj takes a step back and then jumps up in the air, he almost remained suspended in the air for a bit with his left-hand outstretched over his head as the ball stuck, similar to the ones Collingwood takes at point, or Shane Thompson off Aamer Sohail at the 1996 World Cup
full ball on off stump, Pollock backs away towards the leg side to make room and lofts the ball over the in-field at cover, he's placed it perfectly in the gap on the boundary
short of a length delivery pushes Khote on the back foot, he defends on the off side
the bouncer banged in slowly at 125 kmh, Pollock backs away and then dabs the ball towards point off the back foot
short of a length ball on off stump at over 150 kmh, Pollock can't do much but get behind the line and defend on the off side
the slower ball at 126 kmh outside off stump, left alone by Pollock
banged in short angling into the right-hander, that was bowled at 148.9 kmh, Khote gets caught in knots and gets hit on the thigh, the ball goes towards third man
full ball into the blockhole on middle stump, dug out towards the leg side by Pollock
full and wide ball outside off stump, Pollock backs away towards leg and then has to reach out for it, he plays the ball towards point
Khote tries to drive a good length ball that angles across him through cover, he gets an outside edge towards third man
Pollock waits on the back foot and opens the face to play the ball late towards third man
short of a length outside off stump, Khote stays in his crease and plays the ball towards deep cover

lbw! Pathan bowls one straight on a good length, Harbhajan walks across his stumps and tries to play the ball on the leg side, the ball bent into the right-hander after pitching in line with the stumps and hit Harbhajan flush on the pad, that would have gone on to hit leg and Pathan has two in two!

caught! Chawla's in the thick of the action, Nayar tried to pull a short ball from Pathan, he took that from outside off stump and sliced it in the air towards mid-on where Chawla settled under a simple catch, Mumbai are crumbling swiftly here
Pollock moves across his stumps and tries to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pad
driven off the front foot towards long-off for a single
pushed with soft hands towards the leg side for one more
nudged off his pads behind square for a single to get off the mark

bowled him! Tiwary tries to make room by backing away towards leg stump and attempts to loft Chawla down the ground, he didn't get to the pitch of the ball, it turned into him, passed the bat, and crashed into middle stump, Chawla's bowling an invaluable spell here
Pollock tries to play the paddle sweep against the leg sip and gets a top edge over Sangakkara's head
powerful hit! Tiwary gets under a full ball and lofts VRV straight back over his head for a massive six, Tiwary looks up to Dhoni and that shot certainly had a touch of Dhoni in it
fuller ball on off stump, Pollock comes forward and drives towards deep cover for a single
now that's an ungainly hit but it's effective! Pollock backs away and pulls a short ball from off stump over the long-on boundary for six
Pollock makes room to a full ball and lofts VRV inside out over cover for four, lovely improvisation and Tendulkar approves in the dug out
short of a length and just a little wide outside off stump, Tiwary cuts it in the air over cover for a single
good length ball on the stumps, Tiwary stands in his crease and hoists the ball straight back over the bowlers head for a two bounce four
played off the pads towards the leg side, fabulous over from Chawla, just one run off it
Pollock goes back and gets hit on the pad, that was missing leg stump

Pollock tries to slog across the line and gets beaten outside off stump, Sangakkara fumbles, Pollock sets off for the run and so does Tiwary, then both batsmen decide against it, there was a run out chance at either end but Punjab couldn't convert
defended on the front foot towards the bowler, Chawla is bowling a mixed bag of deliveries, that was the googly
Pollock tries to cut the ball but mis-times it on the off side
Tiwary tries to blast Chawla down the ground but his mis-times it high it the air, to his credit he hit it right over the bowler so the ball fell safely between mid-on and mid-off
good length ball on off and middle stump, Tiwary stands in his crease and swipes across the line, he mis-times it towards square leg
short of a length once again, Tiwary gets tucked up on the back foot, he tries to nudge it to the leg side but plays it back to the bowler in the end
quick delivery at 140 kmh in the channel outside off stump, Tiwary fends at it and gets beaten
short of a length ball outside off stump, Pollock runs the ball down to third man for a single
VRV bangs in the bouncer, Pollock fends it awkwardly towards the off side, that hit him on the shoulder

caught! Uthappa's leaned across to a good length ball and chipped it, he's chipped it straight to Sarwan at midwicket, the ball lobbed up for him to take the easiest of catches, big big wicket and now Punjab have this match in control
full ball and Tiwary takes a step down and drives powerfully towards the long-on boundary, sweet way to get going
Tiwary gets beaten by the googly outside off stump, five dots and a wicket in the over so far, fantastic
bowled him! Chawla pumps his fists in celebration! Bravo came forward and tried to loft the quicker and straighter one over midwicket, he missed and Chawla hit middle stump
that was the googly, Bravo moved back and tried to cut but missed, that was bowled at pace too, three dots in a row
defended back towards the bowler on the front foot
Bravo tries to loft Chawla over cover but gets beaten by the turn
good length delivery on middle stump, Bravo tries to heave it on the leg side but gets a thick outside edge through cover
Sreesanth had overstepped, Uthappa tried to pull the ball but got a top edge which fell safely past square leg, he didn't hit that well at all, it was a top edge but Mumbai have a free hit coming up
Bravo drives very straight and the ball bounces off Uthappa's bat and goes towards long on
that's not that short at all but Bravo moves across his stumps and pulls the ball between midwicket and mid-on for four, he got into position quickly which was the  key to the shot
short of a length outside off stump, it was the outswinger from Sreesanth and Bravo was beaten as he tried to run it down to third man
fuller and straighter from Sreesanth, Uthappa drives towards long-off for one more
smack that! Uthappa walks out of his crease and hoists Sreesanth high in the air over long-on, what timing and he hit that very a straight bat
this time he does sweep and plays it to the fielder at short fine leg for a single
Uthappa tries to sweep again but gets hit on the pad outside the line of off stump
Uthappa tries to play the paddle sweep again but misses, Chawla had strayed down leg side
defended on the front foot towards the off side
excellent improvisation, Uthappa moves forward and across his stumps and paddles sweeps a fast and flat delivery extremely fine past the fielder at short fine leg
that's a bit short outside off, Bravo moves back and punches the ball through cover for a single
bowled flat and straight on middle stump, Bravo comes forward and defends towards midwicket
full ball on middle stump, Bravo pushes the ball towards mid-on for the single
Bravo waits on the back foot and punches towards cover, Uthappa was backing up too far and had the fielder at cover hit the stumps at the bowler's end Uthappa might have been struggling
that's not short enough to pull and hence Uthappa mis-timed it towards midwicket, that was 142kmh from Sreesanth on off and middle stump
Uthappa waits in his crease for a good length ball on off stump and defends back to the bowler
full delivery on middle stump, Uthappa strides forward and drives firmly towards Pathan at mid-on who slips and fumbles
good length delivery outside off stump, Bravo opens the face and runs the ball behind point for a single
excellent come back, VRV pitches on a good length just outside off, Uthappa pushes at it without moving his feet and gets beaten
VRV attempts a slower ball which finishes up as a high full toss outside off stump, Uthappa drives the ball through point for four more
pushed towards the off side for a quick single, both Bravo and Uthappa are very swift between the wickets
excellent shot, full of Caribbean flair, Bravo leans across and flicks a ball off his pads over midwicket, lovely timing
Bravo tries to run the ball towards third man but plays it towards first slip on the bounce
he starts with a slightly short ball which Bravo lofts over mid-on for four, sweetly timed
Pathan finishes a super over with another slower one, Uthappa once again gets beaten outside off stump
another slower ball at 116 kmh outside off stump, Uthappa tries to run it down to third man but misses
whipped off the pads towards square leg, straight to the fielder through
dropped by Sarwan! Pathan beat Bravo with a slower ball, he chipped it in the air straight to cover where Sarwan dropped a sitter, Bravo's been let off by his West Indian team-mate!
terribly wide outside off stump, he'll have to bowl that one again
full ball on off stump, driven back towards the bowler, Pathan fields sharply on his follow through
good length ball on middle and leg, played off the pads on the leg side
the slower ball at 116 kmh, Bravo gets behind the line and defends
too full on the pads, Bravo gets off the mark with a lovely flick through midwicket for four

Lee's on fire! Robin Uthappa dropped a ball with soft hands towards the off side and called for the single, Ronchi was late is setting off but he had no chance as Lee sprinted towards the ball, picked it up cleanly adn it one fluid motion threw down the stumps at the batsman's end, Ronchi was way short and Lee is pumped! What celebrations

caught! Lee you beauty! He bowled a full and fast ball at Jayasuriya who drove it in the air right back at Lee who went down on his knees on his follow through and took a low catch, he had very little time to react, what an athlete Lee is, such mobility
again Lee is too quick for Jayasuriya who gets a bottom edge as he tries to cut it on the off side
slower ball on middle stump, Jayasuriya gets behind the line of the ball and blocks
Ronchi tries to work the ball on the leg side and gets hit on the pad
sublime straight drive! Ronchi stays in his crease, waits for a short of a length ball and punches the ball right past the bowler for four, 12 runs off the over so far
too full and too far down leg side, Ronchi aims to swing it behind square on the leg side but can't make contact
good length ball on middle stump, Ronchi flicks the ball uppishly towards midwicket
pushed off the pads towards midwicket
Pathan's pitches short on leg stump, Ronchi swivels and pulls the ball high and far over the long leg boundary, the Mumbai Indians theme blares out in celebration of the innings' first six
131 kmh is much easier to play, Jayasuriya waits on the back foot and cuts in front of point for a single to get off the mark
152.4 kmh, tremendous pace from Lee outside the off stump, Ronchi has a waft at it but misses
149.8 kmh, that's just too quick for Jayasuriya, he moved across his stumps to try and work the ball on the leg side and was hit on the pad, Ronchi called him through for a leg bye
another yorker from Lee, it swings late into Jayasuriya who once again gets beaten and hit on the pad

that's a corker of a yorker! Lee sears it into leg stump, the ball was swinging into Jayasuriya who was beaten completely and struck on the pad, there's a loud appeal for lbw but it was slipping down leg
short and wide outside off stump, Ronchi stays in his crease and guides it towards third man
good length ball outside off stump, Ronchi lets it go through to Sangakkara
